name: application-status-page-board
title: Status Page Board
description: Grouped service list with operational/degraded/outage pills and per-service uptime bars, driven by a typed groups/services prop contract.
useWhen: A public or internal status page needs to show the health of multiple grouped services at a glance.
Each service benefits from a short recent-history strip (uptime bars) alongside its current state pill.
Services are naturally grouped (e.g. Core services, Infrastructure) rather than a single flat list.
avoidWhen: You only need a single aggregate health indicator — a Connection Status Pill is lighter for that case.
You need a chronological log of past incidents — pair this board with a separate incident history list.
Real-time per-minute granularity is required — this component summarizes into discrete bars, not a live chart.
responsiveBehavior: Each service row stays on one line with the uptime bars and status pill right-aligned; on very narrow viewports, let the row wrap so the pill remains fully legible.
accessibility: Status pills pair a color dot with a text label ('Operational', 'Degraded', 'Outage'), never color alone.
The uptime bar strip is marked aria-hidden since it is a supplementary visual summary — the status pill is the accessible source of truth.
Group headings use distinct typography (uppercase, muted) to separate sections without relying on spacing alone.

variants.title: Status Page Board
variants.description: Grouped service board with an overall status header, per-group service rows showing a 6-bar uptime strip and a status pill, and a footer caption.
accessibility: Each status pill's color is reinforced by a text label so status is never communicated by color alone.

variants.title: Status Page Board (Dark)
variants.description: Service status board adapted for dark surfaces with the same grouped-list, uptime-bar, and status-pill structure.
accessibility: Status pill colors and uptime bar colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
